_comment: radioss-crash: explicit-dynamics crash tier on OpenCourant (the community fork of OpenRadioss, AGPL-3.0; upstream repos taken down Oct 2026). Pinned to the latest-20261011 linux64 zip (sha256 checked at image build). Generated square-tube axial crush (pure-python deck writer) or verbatim user decks; mean crush force vs the Wierzbicki-Abramowicz closed form as a screen-level reference. Validated in-image 2026-10-14; see docs/validation/radioss-20261014.

radioss-crash.description: Explicit-dynamics crash on OpenCourant (OpenRadioss fork). mode=tube: parametric square thin-walled tube axial crush — 4-node shells, LAW2 (PLAS_JOHNS), TYPE7 frictionless self-contact, fixed rigid wall + free-flight impactor; reports impactor reaction (impulse->force), mean crush force over the steady window, crush distance, energy balance, and optionally the Wierzbicki-Abramowicz closed form (1983) as reference. mode=deck: user <name>_0000.rad/_0001.rad run verbatim. Decks are kg-mm-ms, 2019 format. Refuses to run without density/stiffness/strength, impactor mass+velocity, or an end time — those are modelling decisions, never defaulted.

cases.case: Square steel tube c=80 h=1.5 L=320 mm (c/h=53), LAW2 perfectly plastic sy=250 MPa, TYPE7 frictionless self-contact, free-flight rigid wall 500 kg at 10 m/s (KE ~8x absorbed), mesh 2.67 mm (14400 shells); crush 143.9 mm
cases.note: expected: Wierzbicki-Abramowicz (1983) P_m = 9.56 sigma0 h^(5/3) c^(1/3) = 20.24 kN with sigma0 = sigma_y. The +25% residual is the known model-form gap of the 1983 reduced-order formula at c/h~50; it shrank from +37% under mesh refinement (see RC-2), the signature of a discretization offset, not a solver error. The closed form carries ~20-30% scatter against experiments itself; this is a screen, not a certification.

cases.case: Same tube, coarse mesh 4.0 mm (6480 shells) — discretization sensitivity datum
cases.note: Coarse run's role is the sensitivity datum: mean force falls 8.6% coarse->fine toward the closed form while the first-fold peak is mesh-independent (129.2 vs 129.7 kN) and the crush distance is identical (143.9 mm). Its own tol is set wide (0.40) because a coarse fold mesh is expected to over-stiffen.

validation.note: Toolchain QA'd end-to-end before the adapter run: the OpenCourant QA decks qa-tests/miniqa/CRASH/crashtriangles (TRITUBV4) ran starter+engine+th_to_csv cleanly in this image (not vendored; CC BY-NC). Starter is invoked with -nspmd 1 (SMP binary, single domain); T01 rigid-wall channels store impulses per the /TH/RWALL reference, so force is d(impulse)/dt — documented in the adapter docstring.
